title: Additional monsoon storage volume
readable: Additional monsoon storage volume = Vd T2

symbols.definition: Volume of digested sludge m³ withdrawn per day
the storage in days, during monsoon

applicability: Section 6.4.5.1: where sludge drying beds alone are used and left open, monsoon rainfall causes environmental problems, so monsoon storage must be provided; this expression fixes the extra volume.
notes: Printed exactly as shown: 'Additional monsoon storage volume = Vd T2', with the whole left-hand side spelled out in words, no multiplication sign and no bracket. The number '(6.2)' is printed at the right margin of the same line.
Vd carries a dropped subscript d and T2 a dropped subscript 2, both printed and both reproduced as subscripts.
Vd is not redefined for this equation; the definition recorded here is the one printed in the equation 6.1 symbol list on the same page ('Volume of digested sludge m³ withdrawn per day').

The only definition printed with this equation is the running line 'Where, T2 is the storage in days, during monsoon', which is not set as an indented symbol list. It is reproduced as a symbol entry and flagged.
Printed as 'Where, T2 is the storage in days, during monsoon' with no closing full stop; kept.
